identity: An active, sturdy blower unit for a powered air purifying respirator system.  Its large triangular body is designed to be worn on the back.  When paired with a prepared PAPR mask, this will provide excellent protection against chemical, biological, radiological, and nuclear threats.  The fan is audibly blowing.
